contacted customer service on XX/XX/year> because i did not receive a paper bill ( as i usually do ) they advised my account had been changed to paperless and the phone number they had on file was unfamiliar. I saw a copy of the bill online at this point i advised the agent i do not recognize multiple transaction on my statement, they then opened a fraud case. In the next couple weeks i got a letter stating my account was credited for the amount disputed. 
In XXXX was the next time i heard from Bank of America stating they were not able to approve the dispute, and the credit was reversed. I contacted them again on XX/XX/XXXX to appeal the denial. In the mean time i was still getting calls to pay on my card and getting charged late fees and interest, i kept advising them my all transactions that are on my card are fraudulent and i would not be paying until resolved. They sent another denial letter on XX/XX/XXXX on the XXXX i contacted them again to advise i still would not be paying because these are fraudulent charges and i still did not receive documents regarding the transactions to date. 
I contacted them again in XX/XX/XXXX to again dispute charges and request documentation regarding transactions in question. On XX/XX/XXXX i contacted them again and said the decision is still pending ( I was on the phone at least XXXX minutes ) the response was XXXX business days. 
These transactions were made possibly by someone in the XXXX. The only description we have is XXXX  XXXX  and XXXX XXXX, we have no affiliation to anyone in the XXXX or order anything from there. I am disappointed they did not contact me regard suspicious activity, I've had this card for XXXX years and have never had these types of foreign transactions on my account. 
Thank you in advance for your support, XXXX XXXX
